what.text: This page follows refugees from Laos living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6145 Lao refugees in France, 94.7% of all refugees from Laos.
France is the largest host of Lao refugees, followed by Spain, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Laos in these years: over the government, with the LRM, in 1990.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Laos.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at its highest figure, 15242 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1995 to 2005, and the figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
